items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And in walks this group from Memphis: George Coleman, Booker Little, Frank Strozier, Harold Mabern... and they proceeded to burn the place down.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. Sun Ra used to come up with his guys, John Gilmore and all. And I remember one year we had a set going with Ira and Nicky Hill, they were burnin’ up. And in walks this group from Memphis: George Coleman, Booker Little, Frank Strozier, Harold Mabern, and they had Bob Cranshaw on bass and Walter Perkins on drums, and

they proceeded to burn the place down. And I remember George had on a big Army overcoat, it must have been in the winter, and an open pair of galoshes. He didn’t take them off, he just opened up the sax case, took out the horn, and they start playing. And it was just fantastic.
